A notes folder in the layout before Sioul's lists left it (November 2026):
the lists at its root, `papers/` and `letters/` in it, as every release up
to 0.0.11 keeps them. The tests of the move (`sioul_core::storage`) copy it
to a stand-in folder and move it; `elsewhere/` holds a paper and a scan kept
outside the notes folder, named by absolute paths that the tests write in.
Fiction only.
